tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header band, result list, details panel.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Idle pills, selected result row, close buttons.

tokens.name: quote-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a checked guide quote only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy, card summaries, the model's explanation.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: source, dates, counts, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and panel outlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: inputs, selects, ghost buttons, chips, toggles. At least 3:1 on bg (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Rules between result rows and table rows.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Saffron. Primary button fill (one per area), eyebrow labels, the logo tile. A fill, never small text on paper; pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Ink on a saffron fill: primary button text, the logo's radar strokes.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text links and text buttons (Details →, Ask guide about this).

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Text on surface-tint pills and paper tags.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px focus outline. On terminals it is term-text.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the active pill or filter; text on it uses on-selected.

tokens.name: on-selected
tokens.usage: Text on a selected fill.

tokens.name: checked-bg
tokens.usage: 'Quote checked' badge and completed progress steps.

tokens.name: checked-ink
tokens.usage: Text on checked-bg.

tokens.name: not-stated
tokens.usage: 'Unknown' values, 'First seen' dates and cautions (cache, rate-limited, stale): facts no source gave or results to treat with care.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only: failed sources, failed requests, rejected claims, form errors. Always with words and an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: tag-model-bg
tokens.usage: Model tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-model-ink
tokens.usage: Model tag text.

tokens.name: tag-news-bg
tokens.usage: News tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-news-ink
tokens.usage: News tag text.

tokens.name: tag-paper-bg
tokens.usage: Paper tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-mcp-bg
tokens.usage: MCP server tag fill; text uses checked-ink.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Source answered. Only on console.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Source served from cache or rate-limited. Only on console.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Radar rings and decorative lines. Never a control border.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Behind the checked sentence in the source text.

tokens.name: proof-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the proof quote in the result preview and the guide pick. Same value as quote-bg.

tokens.name: proof-mark
tokens.usage: Highlight on the one sentence the guide checked, inside the proof quote.

tokens.name: pill-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill: Updated, Published, Quote checked.

tokens.name: pill-ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the ok status pill.

tokens.name: pill-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill: First seen (the source gave no date).

tokens.name: pill-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the warn status pill.

tokens.name: pill-next-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill of the next event. Has a 1px pill-next-line outline.

tokens.name: pill-next-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the next-event pill.

tokens.name: pill-next-line
tokens.usage: 1px inset outline of the next-event pill.

tokens.name: pill-later-bg
tokens.usage: Status pill of later events.

tokens.name: pill-later-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the later-event pill.

tokens.name: pill-later-line
tokens.usage: 1px inset outline of the later-event pill.

tokens.name: tag-other-bg
tokens.usage: Type tag for Product, Agent, Event and the rest. Text in ink-2.

tokens.name: source-tile-bg
tokens.usage: One tile in the sources grid under the results.

tokens.name: source-tile-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a source tile.

tokens.name: row-selected-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the selected result row and its phone preview.

tokens.name: status-ok-ink
tokens.usage: Status words and icons: answered, checked, succeeded.

tokens.name: status-warn-ink
tokens.usage: Status words and icons: slow, rate limited, timed out, sources disagree, not stated.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal windows: New this week, Coming up.

tokens.name: term-bar
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar.

tokens.name: term-text
tokens.usage: Terminal text, the cursor, the third window dot.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Terminal dates, sources, places. 8:1 on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-tag
tokens.usage: News type tags in a terminal: [model], [library].

tokens.name: term-tag-2
tokens.usage: Event timing in a terminal: [tomorrow], [in 2 days]. 4.8:1 on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Terminal outline. Needed in dark, where term-bg is close to bg.

tokens.name: term-control
tokens.usage: Border of buttons inside a terminal. 4.8:1 on term-bg.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Feed card titles and the guide's echoed question.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: An exact sentence from the source.

styles.name: input
styles.sample: Search or ask anything about AI

styles.name: mono-m
styles.usage: Resource names in results and details.

type.note: Geist Mono for the logo, headings, controls, labels, meta lines and terminals. Geist for running text: paragraphs, list items, quotes, descriptions. Both self-hosted (SIL Open Font License).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and inside card headers.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked card parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (vertical), gaps in grids.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Home hero padding, space below the main column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Close buttons, small text buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, quotes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The search box, result list, guide picks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, guide picks and the guide answer panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, tags, badges.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any control.

tokens.name: box-height
tokens.usage: The home search box and its button. 50px on phones, 46px in the header.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The sticky header. 65px on phones. The pinned search box sits right under it.

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column (header, home, lists).

tokens.name: list-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the result list next to the preview panel.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone. Board rows get less padding, boards get shorter.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: Small screen. Page gutter 16px, the search box takes its own row, action buttons share the row.

tokens.name: bp-split
tokens.usage: Below this the result preview panel hides; the selected row opens an inline preview, and the resource page.

tokens.name: bp-two-col
tokens.usage: Below this News and Events stack in one column.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of one-column pages: Results, Resource, Saved, Account.

tokens.name: motion
tokens.usage: Hover and state changes. 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: fold
tokens.usage: The phone hero folding away, the pinned box getting compact.

tokens.name: radar-beam
tokens.usage: The home radar beam turns once every 5 s on one JavaScript clock with the dots; it stops while the search box has focus. Still under prefers-reduced-motion and with the account setting off.

tokens.name: radar-step
tokens.usage: The first 3 radar sources come 0.6 s apart; then one comes or goes every 1.6 s, 3 to 5 at a time.

tokens.name: radar-contact
tokens.usage: A radar dot when the beam passes it: full opacity, scale 1.35 back to 1, a glow in its colour, then it fades to 0.22. A source that leaves fades to 0 within 3 s.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Terminal windows only.

tokens.name: shadow-pinned
tokens.usage: The search box once it is pinned while scrolling.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the account panel, the phone menu.
